description: This file defines a configuration class for a PostgreSQL Vector Store, inheriting from an OpenAI-compatible vector store configuration. It includes methods for environment validation (primarily API key management), URL construction, and transforming search requests. The class is part of a larger system integrating with a PG Vector service, providing necessary security and endpoint handling.
